name: sunodoopower
description: SunPower Solutions - Solar Installation Management System

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @sunodoopower/api" "npm run dev -w @sunodoopower/web"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @sunodoopower/api && npm run build -w @sunodoopower/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm run start -w @sunodoopower/api" "npm run start -w @sunodoopower/web"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed && npm run assets
